deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.

display_name.description:
A user-assigned display name of the Fleet. When present, it must be between 4 to 30 characters.
Allowed characters are: lowercase and uppercase letters, numbers, hyphen, single-quote, double-quote, space, and exclamation point.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

default_cluster_config.description: The default cluster configurations to apply across the fleet.

default_cluster_config.binary_authorizat.description: Enable/Disable binary authorization features for the cluster.
Mode of operation for binauthz policy evaluation. Possible values: ["DISABLED", "POLICY_BINDINGS"]
Binauthz policies that apply to this cluster.

The relative resource name of the binauthz platform policy to audit. GKE
platform policies have the following format:
'projects/{project_number}/platforms/gke/policies/{policy_id}'.

default_cluster_config.security_posture_.description: Enable/Disable Security Posture features for the cluster.
Sets which mode to use for Security Posture features. Possible values: ["DISABLED", "BASIC", "ENTERPRISE"]
Sets which mode to use for vulnerability scanning. Possible values: ["VULNERABILITY_DISABLED", "VULNERABILITY_BASIC", "VULNERABILITY_ENTERPRISE"]
